priceOne: Wannan binciken zai ci kiredit {n}. Ba za a yi amfani da kiredit ba sai ka danna “Bincika”.
priceSphere: Yankin harshe yana cin kiredit {lo}–{hi} gwargwadon yawan ƙasashensa. Ba za a yi amfani da kiredit ba sai ka danna “Bincika”.
searchingHint: Wannan na iya ɗaukar minti ɗaya ko biyu. Za ka iya ci gaba da rubutu.
emptyHint: Bincika da Factdock, sannan ka saka kowane sakamako a cikin bayaninka tare da tushensa.
already: Wannan tushe yana cikin bayanin tuni.
apiKeyDesc: Samu maɓalli a shafin API na manhajar Factdock (tsare-tsaren biya). Yana farawa da fdu_.
folderDesc: “Sabon bayani” yana ƙirƙirar bayani ɗaya ga kowane sakamako a cikin wannan babban fayil.
about: Ana aika kalmomin bincikenka zuwa Factdock (fact-dock.com) ne kawai lokacin da ka fara bincike. Ba a aika wani abu dabam daga ma'ajiyarka. Adana sakamako a cikin bayanai kyauta ne; kowane bincike yana amfani da kiredit daga tsarinka na Factdock.
errNetwork: Ba a iya isa ga Factdock ba. Duba haɗin intanet ɗinka.
errServer: Factdock ba ya samuwa na ɗan lokaci. Sake gwadawa daga baya.
